statements.status_notes: WS-2026-0134 is the SCA vendor's advisory identifier for a jackson-dataformat-yaml issue that does not yet have a published CVE. PingFederate carries this library only as a transitive dependency, and code review found no PingFederate code path that parses attacker-supplied YAML at runtime. On that basis we assess PingFederate as not vulnerable to this advisory. The library will be updated in a regular dependency refresh.
